labels.DUTY: The action, appointment, task, or event the user wants scheduled.
labels.DATE: A resolvable date or relative date/time expression, e.g. tomorrow, next Friday, in two hours.
labels.TIME: A clock time or daypart, e.g. 3 pm, 14:30, morning.
labels.DURATION: How long the event/task lasts, e.g. 45 minutes, two hours.
labels.REMINDER: A requested reminder lead time, e.g. 10 minutes before, one hour before.
labels.TIME_WINDOW: A range/window rather than one exact instant, e.g. in the next 3 days, sometime next week.
labels.RECURRENCE: A repeating schedule, e.g. every Monday, daily, each weekday.

rules: Offsets refer to the normalized 'text' field.
The original user wording is preserved in 'original_text'.
NER identifies spans; deterministic code still resolves/validates actual datetimes.
Ambiguous time expressions are labeled but must not be guessed by the scheduler.
